title: Abelian varieties and their dimension survive field extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], and let $A/k$ be an abelian variety [def-sc-abelian-variety]. Give the base change $A_K=A\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-pc-base-change] the group operations obtained by base changing those of $A$ [def-sc-group-scheme]. Then $A_K$ is an abelian variety over $K$, and $\dim A_K=\dim A$ [def-pc-dimension].

source.place: Tag 0BFB (lemma-abelian-variety-change-field). Dimension: morphisms.tex, Tag 02FY (lemma-dimension-fibre-after-base-change), part (1), for the structure map to Spec k.

proof.text: Write $f:A\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. Base change gives $m_K,i_K,e_K$ on $A_K$. For any $K$-scheme $T$, the fibre-product universal property identifies $A_K(T)$ with $A(T)$, where $T$ is regarded as a $k$-scheme. The maps $m_K,i_K,e_K$ therefore satisfy the same group identities on every $T$, and hence as morphisms. In particular $e_K$ is a section of $A_K\to\operatorname{Spec}K$. The original identity $e$ is a section of $f$, so $A$ is nonempty.

source.place: Tag 0BFB (lemma-abelian-variety-change-field), omitted group-structure verification by the fibre-product universal property.

proof.text: By the definition of an abelian variety, $f$ is proper and smooth and $A$ is connected. Apply both clauses of [lem-pc-proper-base-change] to $f$ and $\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. The structure map $A_K\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is proper and smooth.

The connected scheme $A$ has the $k$-rational section $e$ supplied by its group structure. Apply [lem-sbc-connected-rational-point-geometrically-connected] with $X=A$ and the given field extension $K/k$: $A_K$ is connected. Together with steps 1 and 2, this is exactly the proper, smooth, connected group-scheme definition of an abelian variety over $K$.

Properness includes finite type, so $A$ is locally of finite type over $k$. Since $A$ is nonempty, [lem-pc-dim-base-change-affine-covers] supplies matching affine open covers $U_i\cong\operatorname{Spec}R_i$ of $A$ and $V_i\cong\operatorname{Spec}(R_i\otimes_kK)$ of $A_K$, with every $R_i$ a finite type $k$-algebra. It also supplies nonemptiness of $A_K$.

source.place: Tags 01JR (lemma-open-fibre-product), 01JQ (lemma-fibre-product-affines); morphisms.tex Tag 01T0, finite-type affine charts.

proof.text: The affine assertion of [lem-pc-dim-base-change] applies separately to each $R_i$ and gives $\dim(R_i\otimes_kK)=\dim R_i$. Apply [lem-pc-dimension-affine-open-cover] to both nonempty schemes and their covers from step 4. Thus $\dim A_K=\sup_i\dim(R_i\otimes_kK)=\sup_i\dim R_i=\dim A$. This computes the supremum of local-ring dimensions used by [def-pc-dimension], without identifying it with the dimension of a local ring at a chosen point.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BFB omits the proof; group operations are checked by the universal property, proper/smooth base change by 01W4/01VB, connectedness by 04KV, and dimension by matching affine covers, 00P3 and 04MU.
